Definition: (only in plural as singular) the setting (of the sun)
BiblicalUsage: The word is the setting of the sun, and Daniel uses it once, of the king who laboured till the going down of the sun to deliver Daniel from the lions' den.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the sunset is the measure of a king's love: Darius worked all day to save one man, and the sun went down on his failure — but God kept Daniel, and the den could not hold him.
